source.name: Sport24, 'Superbet kai Olympiakos mazi mechri to 2032' (Superbet and Olympiacos together until 2032)
source.quote: η οποία θα αποτελέσει τον Μεγάλο Χορηγό της ομάδας έως το 2032
source.note: Sport24 publishes the club's announcement: Superbet will be the 'Great Sponsor' (Μεγάλο Χορηγό) until 2032; deal reportedly worth EUR 55m including bonuses. News24/7 (8 July 2026, olympiacos-i-nea-fanela-...-superbet) says the new 2026-27 kit carries the Superbet logo on the front of the jersey; the club store's photos of the 26/27 home jersey show SUPERBET across the chest.

source.name: Gazzetta: Το ιδιαίτερο σημείο που μπήκε η χορηγία του ΑρρένΑ στην φανέλα του Ολυμπιακού (The particular spot where ArrenA's sponsorship goes on Olympiacos' jersey)
source.quote: το λογότυπο της εταιρίας σας, της ΑρρένΑ θα βρίσκεται στην φανέλα της αγαπημένης σας ομάδας, κάτω από τον δαφνοστεφανομένο έφηβο
source.note: Translation: 'your company's logo, ArrenA, will be on your favourite team's jersey, under the laurelled youth (the club crest).' Three-year deal presented 9 July 2025, so covering 2026-27. The club store's home-jersey photos (olympiacosbc.shop, August 2026) show the small 'ArrènA Natural Mineral Water' logo on the upper right chest, next to the crest.

summary: Superbet across the front (first season, deal to 2032) and Tsakos-family water brand Arrena as a small chest logo. Official club store photos show the back printing 'PIRAEUS' and the shorts carrying only the club crest, so the list is complete.
